notes.heading: The Diff Gear Axle's boss
notes.text: The boss is the Ø{axle_boss_d} collar, 2 mm tall, that hangs below the axle's hub around the CF rod. It is the spacer that stops the axle on the Diff Gear Shaft's front MR128: its tip face lands on the bearing's inner race, and a chamfer takes its edge clear of the shield. That holds the hub off the shaft's end, which turns with the other input. The rod bore is Ø{axle_rod_bore}, so the boss has {axle_boss_wall} mm of wall around it, and {axle_boss_face_wall} mm across its tip face, against {axle_boss_wall_measured} mm on the reference part. The boss runs from z {axle_boss_z_low} to {axle_boss_z_high}. The MR85 is pressed into the axle's flat back, and the CF rod is epoxied in the bore below it.
